title: Morning Brief
intro_md: Thursday, Oct 8, 2026. Type "more on G3" (or any code) in chat with April, or tap More info and paste the request there, for a deeper dive.

items.headline_md: Russian glide bomb hits two buses in Kramatorsk, killing 33
items.summary_md: Donetsk officials say 18 more were wounded and accuse Russia of targeting passenger buses; the attack comes amid a surge in Russian strikes and civilian casualties.

items.headline_md: Update: Trump says he no longer wants an Iran deal as the US reportedly weighs 'massive bombing'
items.summary_md: NBC and Axios report that the White House has discussed resuming large-scale strikes on Iranian energy, infrastructure and nuclear targets in the coming weeks, possibly before the midterms.

items.headline_md: Tanker hit by multiple projectiles in the Gulf north of Qatar, with casualties
items.summary_md: UKMTO says the laden oil and chemical tanker Acers was struck 51 nautical miles off Madinat al-Shamal; the IMO counts at least 24 seafarers killed in 93 incidents since the Iran war began in February.

items.headline_md: Update: Isaias is now a hurricane and is expected to strengthen before a Gulf Coast landfall
items.summary_md: With winds around 80 mph early Thursday, it's forecast to hit the Florida Panhandle, southern Alabama and Mississippi late Friday or early Saturday; Florida and Alabama have declared emergencies.

items.headline_md: Eritrean troops move deep into Ethiopia's Tigray region, residents say
items.summary_md: Residents of Adigrat told the BBC they saw truckloads of Eritrean soldiers heading south toward fighting that broke out two weeks ago between Ethiopia's army and Tigrayan forces.

items.headline_md: South Korea recalls its ambassador to Ukraine over a prisoner-of-war row
items.summary_md: Seoul says Kyiv broke an agreement to keep secret its transfer of two captured North Korean soldiers to South Korea; Zelensky's office says no such agreement existed.

items.headline_md: Margaret Hamilton, whose software helped land Apollo 11 on the Moon, dies at 90
items.summary_md: MIT confirmed the pioneering computer scientist, who led the Apollo flight-software team and popularized the term 'software engineering,' died on Sept 30.

items.headline_md: PepsiCo beats on Q3 but cuts its full-year profit forecast
items.summary_md: Core EPS growth is now seen at 2.5% to 3.5% (from the low end of 5% to 7%) as North America keeps lagging international markets.

items.headline_md: Samsung guides to a record Q3 operating profit of about $80.2B
items.summary_md: Preliminary profit of 107.4 trillion won is up 782% on the year on AI memory demand, though an eToro analyst says it still fell short of lofty expectations.

items.headline_md: TSMC's September revenue jumps 54.6% year over year
items.summary_md: Sales hit NT$511.86 billion ($16.03 billion), down 0.6% from August; Q3 results are due next week.

items.headline_md: Canada's Weston family buys UK pharmacy chain Boots for $8.9bn
items.summary_md: The former Selfridges owners are buying the high-street chain from longtime backer Stefano Pessina.

items.headline_md: NFL tells the Supreme Court that sports prediction markets are gambling and belong to the states
items.summary_md: In a brief backing New Jersey against Kalshi, the league says football drew $1.8 billion of prediction-market trading on the season's first Sunday.

items.headline_md: Asos hackers took far more customer data than first disclosed
items.summary_md: Names, addresses, phone numbers, emails and even site search history are now in criminals' hands, raising the risk of targeted phishing.

items.headline_md: Xbox launches 'XP,' a division for film, TV, consumer products and live events
items.summary_md: Mojang president Kayleen Walters will run it, building on franchises from Minecraft and Call of Duty to Candy Crush and Halo.

items.headline_md: Monster Hunter Rise is coming to iOS and Android, but only through Netflix for now
items.summary_md: After 20 million sales on Switch, PC and other consoles, Capcom's hit is heading to mobile behind a Netflix subscription.

items.headline_md: Monopoly Go was the biggest US mobile-game advertiser in August
items.summary_md: Sensor Tower estimates also put it top for US IAP revenue at $93.8M, with Royal Match second ($64.8M) and the only top-10 game growing downloads by double digits.

items.headline_md: Fire Emblem Shadows made just $892,000 in its first year on mobile
items.summary_md: That's about 0.3% of what Fire Emblem Heroes made in its first year.

items.headline_md: PUBG Mobile Light is renamed PUBG Mobile Flash ahead of launch
items.summary_md: Krafton's lighter PUBG Mobile spin-off gets a new name before release.

items.headline_md: Sony is reportedly reviving Ape Escape with the Sonic Mania developers
items.summary_md: The studio behind Sonic Mania and Penny's Big Breakaway is said to be on it, and it's reportedly not the only PlayStation reboot in the works.

sections.title: Video Game Emulation
sections.body_md: Wii U lifter watch: still no public repo or release from u/Mindstormman's general Wii U lifter in GitHub searches this morning, and r/decomps and r/emulation couldn't be read (Reddit returned 403). A separate, very early Wind Waker HD static-recomp repo (flossbud/WWHDRecomp) appeared overnight but says it's just getting started. No verified Switch 2 commercial-game emulation news.

items.headline_md: An unofficial native RPCS3 port runs PS3 games on a jailbroken PS5 Pro, no Linux needed
items.summary_md: Developer lavavex's build uses a RADV Vulkan port and DualSense input; Need for Speed Carbon is reported fully playable at 60 FPS on firmware 13.60, while the RPCS3 team says it has no interest in an official port.

items.headline_md: bbport runs Bloodborne's PS4 code natively on Linux PCs
items.summary_md: The open-source project runs the game's x86-64 executable directly on the CPU with a game-specific runtime, translating graphics to Vulkan through an extended shadPS4 renderer; a full playthrough isn't verified yet.

items.headline_md: New public Wii U static recompiler (Brandraft/wiiu-recomp) boots Monster Hunter 3 Ultimate into the village
items.summary_md: Posted Oct 7, the PowerPC RPX-to-C translator and Linux runtime reaches character creation, village dialogue and the HUD; free movement and quests aren't verified (this isn't the r/decomps lifter).

items.headline_md: inFAMOUS Second Son is reportedly playable start to finish on PC via a custom shadPS4 build
items.summary_md: Reports show 30-50 FPS at 1440p on a Ryzen 7 5700X, with a few visual issues remaining.

items.headline_md: FEX 2610 adds AVX-VNNI support for running x86 games on ARM64 Linux
items.summary_md: The monthly release of the emulator used by Valve's Steam Frame also caps disk-cache size and restores 3DNow! handling.

items.headline_md: Update: Verity made $3.55M on Tuesday (Oct 6) for a $38.0M domestic total
items.summary_md: Box Office Mojo's daily chart has Resident Evil second ($127.9M total after 19 days), while Tom Cruise's Digger is at $9.9M after five days.

items.headline_md: Spider-Man: Brand New Day nears $955M domestic
items.summary_md: It's still in 1,724 theaters after 68 days at $954,994,964, while The Odyssey sits at $620.8M after 82 days.

items.headline_md: Update: Other Mommy now eyes a No. 1 opening around $20M this weekend (Oct 9-11)
items.summary_md: Deadline sees about $20M from 3,200 theaters for the $19M Jessica Chastain horror film, down from earlier tracking as high as $35M; previews start Thursday at 2 p.m.

items.headline_md: Update: Aaron Sorkin's The Social Reckoning now targets just $7M to $8M
items.summary_md: That would be well under the $22M opening of 2010's The Social Network.

items.headline_md: Elsinore, with Andrew Scott and Olivia Colman, opens the London Film Festival
items.summary_md: Scott is already drawing big awards buzz for his performance.

items.headline_md: Brad Bird's long-gestating Ray Gunn debuts this weekend at the London Film Festival
items.summary_md: Deadline talks to Bird about the 30-year road to bringing it to the screen with Skydance and Netflix.

items.headline_md: Indian actor Nana Patekar dies suddenly at 75
items.summary_md: The three-time National Film Award winner was found unconscious at his home in Goa and couldn't be revived.

items.headline_md: OpenAI brings GPT-6 to ChatGPT with 'Intelligent UI'
items.summary_md: Responses can now include interactive charts, graphs, pictures and buttons right in the conversation.

items.headline_md: Anthropic releases Claude Haiku 5.5
items.summary_md: Its smallest, cheapest model jumps from version 4.5 to 5.5, about a year after the last Haiku upgrade.

items.headline_md: Manus raises more than $500M after Beijing blocked Meta's acquisition
items.summary_md: Boyu Capital and IDG led the round; Bloomberg had reported it would double Manus's valuation to $4B.

items.headline_md: Microsoft gives Copilot more control over Windows and your files
items.summary_md: New 'Hybrid Intelligence' features let Copilot use files on your PC to take actions.

items.headline_md: Hermes Agent maker Nous Research raises $90M at a $1.5B valuation
items.summary_md: Robot Ventures led, with Nvidia and Samsung among backers; the startup says Hermes drives about 2.5% of global AI token use.

items.headline_md: Google opens its SynthID checker to everyone
items.summary_md: The site checks whether images, video or audio were made with AI.

items.headline_md: Google defends Play Store commissions in a £1bn UK class action
items.summary_md: The case, which opened Oct 6, covers about 20M UK consumers and argues that commissions of up to 30% were passed on to buyers; Google says its fees are among the lowest.

items.headline_md: Meta rolls out AI tools to catch harmless-looking ads that lead to child abuse material
items.summary_md: Meta says it acted on 33.2M pieces of child-exploitation content in the first half of 2026, more than 97% found before users reported it.

items.headline_md: Microsoft's Surface Laptop Ultra with an Nvidia AI chip starts at $2,599
items.summary_md: Preorders are open now and it ships Oct 16, with what Microsoft calls the first magnetic USB-C port.

items.headline_md: ICANN's new top-level domain applications are mostly about AI
items.summary_md: Applications range from .agent and .agi to .openai and .jackpot.

items.headline_md: India rejects Musk's claim that 'oligarchs' are blocking Starlink
items.summary_md: The communications ministry says Starlink and two other satellite operators are at the same regulatory stage, with security reviews still pending.

items.headline_md: Teenage Engineering's CEO says it will stop making synths
items.summary_md: That could spell the end for the iconic OP-1, he said in a Highsnobiety interview.

items.headline_md: Futures fall as yields and oil climb: Dow −0.77%, S&P 500 −0.45%, Nasdaq 100 −0.68% (4:56 AM AZ)
items.summary_md: Dow futures were at 51,054 (−395), S&P 500 futures at 7,817.25 and Nasdaq 100 futures at 31,190.25.

items.headline_md: 10-year Treasury yield rises to 5.328%, about 5 bp higher (5:06 AM AZ)
items.summary_md: CNBC says that's around levels not seen since 2002, after Fed Governor Waller said more hikes may be needed.

items.headline_md: Oil jumps about 4.4% on Iran escalation fears: Brent $104.64, WTI $92.21; gold $4,150.40 (+0.2%) (4:56 AM AZ)
items.summary_md: Brent topped $105 earlier in the session, CNBC reported.

items.headline_md: Bitcoin slips 1.4% to about $82,177 (5:06 AM AZ)
items.summary_md: It's down about $1,190 on the day.

items.headline_md: Premarket movers: Wolfspeed +15% on a $1.5B Pentagon loan, Haemonetics +8%, Broadcom −2%, Levi −3% (as of 4:42 AM AZ)
items.summary_md: Broadcom fell on a WSJ report that it's arranging more than $50 billion in financing tied to its OpenAI chips.

items.headline_md: Fed minutes show most officials see another rate hike as likely by year end
items.summary_md: They gave no timing; the Fed meets next on Oct 28 and Dec 9.

items.headline_md: Phoenix, AZ: Sunny, high near 102°F, low around 81°F tonight
items.summary_md: Precipitation chance is 1% with no rain expected, and there are no active alerts.

items.headline_md: Show Low, AZ: Sunny, high near 77°F, low around 53°F tonight, slight chance of showers
items.summary_md: NWS gives a 20% chance of rain showers between 11 a.m. and 5 p.m. (no amount forecast), and there are no active alerts.

items.headline_md: Snowflake, AZ: Sunny, high near 81°F, low around 55°F tonight
items.summary_md: Precipitation chance is 1% with no rain expected, and there are no active alerts.

items.headline_md: BBC and NPR find the US and Lebanon are protecting a Syrian general wanted for crimes against humanity
items.summary_md: It's a deep investigation into why Bassam al-Hassan, who oversaw Assad's chemical weapons program, is being sheltered in exchange for information on abducted US journalist Austin Tice.
